subscribe.lede: Pick a rate, pay by UPI, and share your details with us.

subscribe.step2Lead: On WhatsApp, send the screenshot and your postal address, name, and phone. A short draft will open for you.
subscribe.qrCaption: Scan with Google Pay, PhonePe, or any UPI app.

subscribe.moreWays: Other ways to pay (NEFT, DD, cheque)
subscribe.payRequired: Use only one of these if you are not paying by UPI.
